verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state you can launch a Browser Use cloud/local browser and connect via its CDP URL, letting your own Playwright/Puppeteer/CDP code drive it instead of rewriting automation (browser-use-docs-2, docs-18, docs-26), and community evidence confirms local CDP/profile connection works in practice (browser-use-comm-5). missing for 10: dedicated Playwright/Puppeteer code sample walkthrough, independent hands-on confirmation specifically for the cloud CDP endpoint (not just local).
